title: QC - Councils, Committees & Partnerships - 003 - QAFL Membership Registration
description:
FRONTEND — Visitor Display & Form Submission
User
Story ID: QC -003 | US-027 | REF: FR-027
Title: QAFL Membership Registration — Visitor Display & Form
Submission
As a public website visitor
I want to access the QAFL
Membership Registration page, review information about the association, and
submit a membership application through a guided multi-step form
So that I can apply for QAFL
membership through Qatar Chamber's official online channel
Preconditions
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and accessible.
- The QAFL Membership Registration page is published in
the CMS.
- The multi-step membership form (Company Identity,
Senior Executive, Responsible Manager, Company Location, Supporting Documents)
is active and visible.
- The QAFL Membership Authorization Letter is uploaded
and available for download.
What the Visitor Sees
- Breadcrumb (Home › Councils, Committees &
Partnerships), and a hero banner titled “QAFL Membership Registration” with the
subtitle “Register your company for QAFL membership by providing verified
company information, authorized contacts, and the required supporting
documents.”
- An informational section with the eyebrow “About the
association,” the heading “An overview of the Qatar Association for Freight
Forwarding and Logistics,” an introductory paragraph, and a 5-point bullet list
covering QAFL's role, FIATA affiliation, and chairmanship.
- A side card labeled “Required template” titled “QAFL
Membership Authorization Letter,” with instructions to download, complete,
sign, and upload the template, and a “Download Authorization Letter” button.
- A 5-step progress indicator (01 Company Identity, 02
Senior Executive, 03 Responsible Manager, 04 Company Location, 05 Supporting
Documents) showing the visitor's current step.
- Step 1 — Company Identity: Company English/Arabic Name,
Company Registered Under (dropdown), a set of additional fields that change
based on the Company Registered Under selection (see below), Company Size,
Company Type, and Market Presence, each with their own conditional fields.
- Step 2 — Senior Executive: CEO/Chairman/Manager Name,
Designation, Email, Confirm Email, Phone, Extension, Mobile Number.
- Step 3 — Responsible Manager: the same field set as
Senior Executive, for the company's operational contact.
- Step 4 — Company Location: Website, Location Name,
Building Number, Zone Number, Street Number.
- Step 5 — Supporting Documents: QAFL Membership
Authorization Letter upload, and Authorized Person Qatar ID (Front & Back)
uploads, followed by CAPTCHA and Submit.
- Previous / Next navigation between steps, and a final
Submit button on the last step.
Company Registered Under — Conditional Behavior
Selecting a value in “Company
Registered Under” reveals a different set of additional required fields
immediately below it, as follows:
- Qatar Ministry of Commerce and Industry (MOCI) —
reveals 5 fields: CR Number, Upload CR Copy, Qatar Chamber Membership Number,
Upload Qatar Chamber Membership Copy, and Verified on Qatar Commercial
Directory?
- Qatar Financial Centre (QFC) — reveals 2 fields: QFC
Number and QFC Membership Copy.
- Qatar Free Zones Authority (QFZ) — reveals 2 fields:
QFZ Number and QFZ Membership Copy.
- Other — reveals 2 fields: Company Registered Under
(Other) and Company Registered Under (Other) Membership Copy.
- Switching the selection swaps the revealed field set;
fields tied to the previous selection are cleared and are no longer required.
Frontend Workflow
- Public Visitor navigates to Main Menu → Councils,
Committees & Partnerships → QAFL Membership Registration.
- Page loads with the hero, the association overview, the
downloadable authorization letter card, and the 5-step membership form.
- Public Visitor reads the association information and
downloads the QAFL Membership Authorization Letter template.
- On Step 1 (Company Identity), the visitor enters
company names and selects a value in Company Registered Under; the system
reveals the corresponding additional fields (5 for MOCI, 2 each for QFC / QFZ /
Other) and marks them required.
- Visitor completes Company Size, Company Type, and
Market Presence; selecting “Other” on Company Size or Company Type, or Regional
/ International / Other on Market Presence, reveals the matching conditional
field(s).
- Visitor proceeds through Step 2 (Senior Executive) and
Step 3 (Responsible Manager), entering executive and operational contact
details.
- Visitor completes Step 4 (Company Location) with the
company's website and registered Qatar address.
- On Step 5 (Supporting Documents), the visitor uploads
the signed Authorization Letter and both sides of the authorized person's Qatar
ID, completes CAPTCHA, and clicks Submit.
- System validates all mandatory fields (including the
fields revealed by Company Registered Under and other conditional selections)
and file constraints.
- On success, the system stores the submission with
status Pending, displays a bilingual acknowledgement message, and sends two
emails: a Submission Confirmation to the applicant and a New Request
Notification to the admin.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the visitor
opens the QAFL Membership Registration page
When
the visitor completes the multi-step form and submits
Then:
- the system shall display the hero, the association
overview with its bullet list, the downloadable authorization letter card, the
5-step progress indicator, and all five form steps in order.
- all mandatory fields on every step shall be validated
with real-time inline validation before the visitor can proceed or submit.
- selecting MOCI under Company Registered Under shall
require CR Number, Upload CR Copy, Qatar Chamber Membership Number, Upload
Qatar Chamber Membership Copy, and Verified on Qatar Commercial Directory?
- selecting QFC shall require QFC Number and QFC
Membership Copy.
- selecting QFZ shall require QFZ Number and QFZ
Membership Copy.
- selecting Other shall require Company Registered Under
(Other) and its Membership Copy upload.
- changing the Company Registered Under selection shall clear
and un-require the fields tied to the previous selection.
- Company Size ‘Other’ shall trigger a conditional field
(max 10 chars).
- Company Type ‘Other’ shall trigger a conditional field
(max 100 chars).
- Market Presence selection (Regional / International /
Other) shall trigger the corresponding conditional field.
- file uploads shall enforce their configured format and
size limits per field (see Field-Level Details).
- CAPTCHA shall be required and validated before
submission.
- duplicate submission prevention is enforced until the
status is InProgress/pending based on email + company name.
- on successful submission, the system stores the record
with status: Pending.
- the system shall display a bilingual acknowledgement
message to the visitor.
- the system shall send a Submission Confirmation email
to the applicant and a New Request Notification email to the admin.
- no email is sent to the applicant at the point of
submission other than the Submission Confirmation — status-change emails are
governed separately by the admin review workflow.
Edge Case Scenarios
- If Company Size = ‘Other,’ a conditional field (max 10
chars) appears and becomes required.
- If Company Type = ‘Other,’ a conditional field (max 100
chars) appears and becomes required.
- If Market Presence = ‘Regional,’ ‘International,’ or
‘Other,’ the matching conditional field appears and becomes required.
- If Company Registered Under is changed after
conditional fields were filled in, previously entered values for the old
selection's fields are discarded.
- If a file format or size is invalid for any upload
field, an inline error appears and submission is blocked.
- If CAPTCHA fails, submission is blocked.
- Session timeout after 60 minutes of inactivity resets
the form.
Negative Scenarios
- Missing mandatory fields on any step trigger real-time
inline validation messages.
- Invalid email format triggers an email format
validation error.
- Non-matching Confirm Email triggers a mismatch error.
Post Condition
QAFL Membership Registration is
stored with Pending status. Visitor receives an on-screen acknowledgement and a
confirmation email.
Success Screen — On Form Submission (Visitor)
English:
Your QAFL Membership Registration has been submitted successfully.
Your application is currently under review. You will be contacted once the
review is completed.
Arabic:
تم إرسال طلب عضوية QAFL بنجاح. طلبكم الآن قيد
المراجعة. سيتم التواصل معكم بعد الانتهاء من مراجعة الطلب.
BACKEND — Admin CMS Management & Request Review
User
Story ID: QC -003 | US-027 | REF: FR-027
Title: QAFL Membership Registration — CMS Management & Request Review
As an authorized admin user
(Site Content Editor / Form Manager)
I want to manage the QAFL
Membership Registration page content and review, approve, or reject submitted
applications
So that Qatar Chamber can
process QAFL membership applications with a clear approval trail
Administrator Workflow
- Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
- Navigates to the QAFL Membership Registration page.
- Manages page content: breadcrumb label, hero (title,
subtitle, background image), the association overview (eyebrow, heading, body,
bullet list), the authorization letter card and its downloadable template file,
and page/section visibility — all EN | AR.
- Saves draft, previews, and publishes.
- Form Manager opens the QAFL Membership Registration
submissions listing.
- Views submitted applications, each showing status
Pending by default.
- Selects a submitted record to view full company,
contact, and document details.
- Updates the request status to Approved or Rejected: if
Approved, the system sends an Approval email to the applicant; if Rejected, the
admin enters a rejection reason and the system saves the status and reason
internally, sending no email.
- System records the action in the audit log.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the admin
reviews a submitted QAFL application
When
the admin updates the status
Then:
- the admin can view all submitted applications with
their current status (Pending / Approved / Rejected).
- new submissions default to status: Pending.
- approving an application shall trigger an Approval
email to the applicant only.
- rejecting an application shall require a rejection
reason before saving, shall store that reason with the record, and shall
produce no email or other external notification.
- all submissions are stored for audit and internal
tracking, including the rejection reason where applicable.
- uploaded files pass security validation (malware scan)
before storage.
- only authorized users (Form Manager / Site Content
Editor) can access submission records.
- the system displays the Liferay generic toast after each
action.
Negative Scenarios
- Attempting to set status to Rejected without entering a
rejection reason shall be blocked with a validation error.
Post Condition
QAFL Membership application
status is updated. The applicant is notified only on Approval; a Rejected application
is closed internally with its reason recorded, with no applicant notification.

Business Rules
- All mandatory fields across all five steps must be completed
before submission, including any conditional fields revealed during the flow.
- Company Registered Under determines which additional
verification fields and document uploads are required: MOCI reveals 5 fields;
QFC, QFZ, and Other each reveal 2 fields.
- Switching the Company Registered Under selection clears
and un-requires the fields tied to the previous selection.
- Company Size = Other, Company Type = Other, and Market
Presence = Regional / International / Other each reveal their own conditional
field, which becomes required once revealed.
- CAPTCHA verification is mandatory and must pass before
form submission.
- Submitted applications are stored with a default status
of Pending for internal review.
- Only Approved status triggers an applicant email
(Approval email); Rejected status sends no email and instead requires and
stores a rejection reason for internal tracking.
- Uploaded files pass security validation (malware scan)
before storage.
- The breadcrumb, hero, page description section, and the
required-template card are fully CMS-configurable in both languages without
code changes.
